audience.text: Developers building .NET applications targeting .NET Framework 4.8, .NET Standard 2.0, or .NET 8+ who need offline OCR for Latin-script text in images and PDFs.

capabilities.text: Embeds detection, refinement, and recognition ONNX models as resources; runs entirely on the local CPU via Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime without external downloads.
capabilities.title: Local OCR with embedded models

capabilities.text: Recognizes Latin-script text including diacritical characters supported by the embedded recognition model, using greedy CTC decoding.
capabilities.title: Latin-script recognition

capabilities.text: Returns detected text lines with System.Drawing.Rectangle coordinates via RecognitionResult.RecognitionLinesResult.
capabilities.title: Line-level coordinates

capabilities.text: Processes raster images and PDF documents via InputType.SingleImage and InputType.PDF, rendering PDF pages at 150 DPI.
capabilities.title: PDF and image input

capabilities.text: Supports netstandard2.0, net48, net8.0, net9.0, and net10.0 through a single package.
capabilities.title: Cross-framework targeting

capabilities.text: Accepts multiple files of the same type in one OcrInput container, preserving order in the OcrOutput results.
capabilities.title: Batch input handling

limitations.text: Image processing is Windows-only due to dependency on System.Drawing.Common for bitmap operations.
No runtime language selection; recognition is limited to Latin-script characters in the embedded model.
PDF rendering resolution is fixed at 150 DPI and not configurable.
Output includes only axis-aligned rectangles; polygonal regions and layout labels are not exposed.
No support for GPU execution; inference uses the CPU execution provider only.
Searchable PDF generation, confidence scores, font detection, table structure, and barcode detection are not implemented.

problems_solved.text: Enables offline OCR without external services or model downloads by embedding detection, refinement, and recognition ONNX models directly in the assembly.
Provides structured output with both recognized text and pixel-level line coordinates for layout-aware processing.
Supports batch processing of multiple images or PDF pages in a single call while preserving input order.

product_summary.text: Aspose.OCR.FOSS is a free, open-source OCR library for .NET that performs local text detection and Latin-script recognition on raster images and PDF documents using embedded ONNX models.

uncertainties: Whether the embedded ONNX models include support for non-Latin scripts beyond diacritical Latin characters.
How the library behaves on non-Windows platforms despite System.Drawing.Common dependency.
Whether the 150-DPI PDF rendering resolution can be adjusted in future versions.
If the public API is stable or subject to breaking changes as capabilities evolve.
How the package size is managed across multiple target frameworks with embedded models.
Whether xUnit tests cover edge cases like corrupted PDFs or unsupported image formats.
If the eight intra-operation worker threads in ONNX Runtime can be configured by the caller.
Whether the license file contains additional terms beyond the SPDX identifier MIT.

workflows.name: Build from source
workflows.text: Build the solution using the .NET CLI with `dotnet build Aspose.Ocr.Foss.sln`.

workflows.name: Run tests
workflows.text: Execute the test suite using `dotnet test Aspose.Ocr.Foss.sln`.

workflows.name: Install via NuGet
workflows.text: Add the package to a project using `dotnet add package Aspose.OCR.FOSS`.

workflows.name: Recognize PDF pages
workflows.text: Create an OcrInput with InputType.PDF, add PDF paths, call AsposeOcr.Recognize, and iterate over RecognitionResult objects.

workflows.name: Recognize single image
workflows.text: Create an OcrInput with InputType.SingleImage, add an image path, call AsposeOcr.Recognize, and access RecognitionResult.RecognitionText.
